objects.name: Java4Shell, NGINX2Shell and more: Why we are not at "Yellow", (Wed, Nov 18th)
objects.description: About a month ago, we went to Infocon Yellow for the first time in a few years. We decided to address the php2shell vulnerability and alert our readers to its significant impact. In the last few days, we had a major Microsoft 365 outage, a critical vulnerability in Java, and a critical vulnerability in NGINX, which was disclosed today.
